base_simulation: APF3_ALIGNED_V4_PROTOCOL.json:simulation, all unchanged assumptions except overdue_policy
overdue_policy: Reject new credit whenever any overdue principal remains; prior partial payments or agreements do not authorize another grant. Resume evaluation only after full settlement is observed. Never accelerate or invent payments to increase grants.

source_units.weekly_clients: Approximately 9 distinct recipients of granted credits
source_units.return_days: Return to request credit, not elapsed time between granted credits
source_units.scheduled_opportunities: The inherited schedule is an explicit scenario assumption, not a measurement of request volume

audit_before_any_model: No granted credit has overdue balance at evaluation
Partial payment never bypasses the overdue block
Snapshots use observed events only; no future plans or scores
Amounts 5..50 PEN and exposure including the request at most 80 PEN
Next-day maturity; separate grace does not relabel late credits
Report requests and actual grants separately, including mean grants and distinct recipients by complete week
Report request-return intervals separately from granted-credit intervals
Report both development candidates even if scale or class adequacy is unfavorable
Do not reseed, force labels, force approvals, or reschedule payment to improve scale or model scores
scale_acceptance: Pending source-coherence review. The V4 team tolerance is a descriptive inherited flag, not an owner-confirmed margin or sufficient acceptance for V5.
unchanged_unknowns: Total customer population and latent heterogeneity
Real predictive performance and permanent loss rate
publication: Local data revision only; no replacement of V4 artifacts, no production changes, no public deployment
